Released 2026-11-08 · [downloads and checksums on GitHub](https://github.com/BuenGenio/backdown-releases/releases/tag/v1.0.0-beta.7) · [Download page](/download/)
The seventh beta of BackDown 1.0: searching by name answers in seconds however big the index, and the search box's Everywhere now covers your other machines too.

## Install

| Platform | Installer | Command line |
|---|---|---|
| Linux x86-64 | `backdown-io_1.0.0-beta.7_amd64.deb` (Debian, Ubuntu) or `.AppImage` | `backdown-v1.0.0-beta.7-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` (static) |
| Linux ARM64 | `backdown-io_1.0.0-beta.7_arm64.deb` or `.AppImage` | `backdown-v1.0.0-beta.7-linux-arm64.tar.gz` (static) |
| macOS (Apple silicon + Intel) | `BackDown-1.0.0-beta.7.dmg` | `backdown-v1.0.0-beta.7-macos-universal.tar.gz` |
| Windows x86-64 | `BackDown-1.0.0-beta.7-x64.msi` (no administrator rights needed) | `backdown-v1.0.0-beta.7-windows-x86_64.zip` |

**This release is signed.** `SHA256SUMS.txt.sig` is an Ed25519 signature of `SHA256SUMS.txt` by BackDown's release key, and `backdown update` checks it before installing anything. To check by hand, see [Air-gapped computers](https://backdown.io/docs/guides/air-gapped/).

The installers and apps themselves still aren't signed by Apple or Microsoft. On macOS, right-click the app and choose Open the first time (for the command-line binary: `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine backdown`). On Windows, SmartScreen may ask you to confirm once.

## What's new since beta.6

### Search answers in seconds

On an index of 27 million files, a search of every drive used to read every file's name and took close to a minute. BackDown now keeps each distinct name once, with an index that finds the names containing what you typed directly. The same search takes a fraction of a second.

- Every drive, one drive or a big folder is searched this way. A small folder is still read through its paths, which was already quick.
- A word that's in a great many names (an extension, say, or a single letter) shows the best matches found within a few seconds and says there are more, rather than counting every one.
- After the upgrade, the service builds this index once, as a job of its own: about 8 minutes for 27 million files. Until it's done, search works as before.

### Everywhere means every machine

With other machines added, the search box's **Everywhere** shows this computer's matches first, then each machine's. A machine's matches appear at once from what was last synced of it, then its own answer replaces them when it gives one. Opening a match opens its folder on that machine.

- What's synced of another machine now includes its folders, worked out from its files' paths, so a folder is found by name there too.
- Another machine gets up to 2 minutes to answer a search, as the phone app allows. A machine that didn't answer in time is no longer asked a second time, which used to double the wait.
- `backdown swarm where` and the Swarm view's search are just as quick.

## Known limitations

- Built locally, not by CI. Every test passed on Linux; the macOS and Windows builds are checked but haven't yet run on those systems. Please report anything that doesn't work: https://github.com/BuenGenio/backdown-releases/issues
- The new index takes some room: on 8.5 million distinct names, about 1.2 GB.
- Searching another machine at its fastest needs beta.7 there too. An older BackDown there still answers, as slowly as before.
- Tags, flags and links are command-line only for now; the browser and the app don't show them yet.
- The installers aren't signed or notarised by Apple or Microsoft.
- Pro, Team and Forensic features are free during the beta; pricing may change before 1.0.
- A machine running Windows can't be the other end of `backdown remote` yet.

Documentation: https://backdown.io/docs/. Provided as-is, without warranty, for evaluation.
